work_item: W2 -- repaired (cut-aligned) pinned-FBT vs stock all-reduce

hardware.gpus: 2x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, single node
hardware.contention: both GPUs were held at 100% utilisation by an unrelated user job for the whole measurement window; an isolated GPU kernel cost a fixed ~2.26 ms scheduling slice, so all timings use BATCHED regions (B back-to-back ops / B) and a co-timed 1-element-add floor probe is recorded beside every case
hardware.comparability: TBIK's <=10% figure is 4xH20 over NVLink on an uncontended node. These are NOT comparable fabrics and the two numbers must not be quoted side by side.

H1_bitwise_reshape_invariance.statement: every (N, M, dtype, backend, world size, deal, rank) cell returned ONE 64-bit root and it equalled the single-process canonical FBT(N) reduction R_can

H1_negative_control.construction: the paper-as-printed index-range partition (T16 proved it is not R_can)
H1_negative_control.verdict: the checker demonstrably CAN fail: at N=1000 and N=1500 the printed construction produced 3 distinct roots over G in {2,3,8} and 0 of 13 cells equalled R_can. At N=1024 it coincides for some G (power-of-two N with G|N) and at N=7 it coincides entirely -- coincidence, not correctness.

H2_cost.outcome: REFUTES the "affordable, TBIK-comparable" branch -- reported as measured, per the pre-registered UNFAVOURABLE branch (a listed irreducible risk)
H2_cost.protocol: median over 15 batched regions of B back-to-back collectives (B=200/50/20 by size), after 2 warm-up batches; overhead = t_pinnedFBT / t_stock

PREREGISTERED_HEADLINE.definition: geomean overhead at G=2, fp64, over the swept sizes (PREREGISTRATION.md:54)

pooled_all_dtypes_NOT_the_headline.note: fp64+fp32 pooled. Reported as the headline in an earlier revision; that deviated from the pre-registration and understated the overhead.

H2_cost.structural_explanation: At G=2 the pinned tree performs one directed send of the full M-vector plus a broadcast of the full M-vector = 2M bytes moved, against a ring all-reduce's M per rank; and it issues two DEPENDENT library calls from Python against one fused NCCL kernel, which dominates below ~1 MiB. The 2-chunk bidirectional variant recovers part of the bandwidth term at 128 MiB (1.85x vs 2.21x) and is much worse below 1 MiB (up to 29x) because it doubles the number of Python-level p2p calls.

CONTENTION_SENSITIVITY.why: The NCCL sweep ran while another user's job saturated both GPUs (observed again 2026-08-28: GPU1 100%, GPU0 72%, load avg 25). The point estimate is therefore contaminated; this bounds by how much.
CONTENTION_SENSITIVITY.CONCLUSION_INVARIANT: The pre-registered SUPPORT branch required roughly 1.0-1.3x. Both estimators exceed it (2.08x best-of-repeats, 2.57x median), so the REFUTE verdict does not depend on the contention correction. The point estimate does, and is reported as provisional.
CONTENTION_SENSITIVITY.status: Re-measurement on a quiet machine still owed; the qualitative finding is not blocked on it.

H3_load_imbalance.outcome: SUPPORTS, with a required paper change
H3_load_imbalance.statement: the frontier assignment does not affect the root, so it is a free load-balancing choice. Greedy LPT: worst 1.969 over the 426 T16 pairs at G<=64, 1.996 over all 1546, 1.993 over 44,850 pairs with N<=300, NONE above 2. The natural contiguous deal reaches 2.48 (45 pairs above 2 at G<=64). The paper must SPECIFY LPT for the <=2 bound to hold.

DEVIATIONS_FROM_PREREGISTRATION.direction: The deviation moved the unfavourable number in the paper's favour.
